Title: Consistent Client Simulation for Motivational Interviewing-based Counseling
Venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
Temporal_Modeling_Details: The framework tracks the client's state (Precontemplation, Contemplation, Preparation, Termination) and controls state transitions turn-by-turn. In Precontemplation, the state transition module analyzes the counselor's utterances to search for mention(s) of the client's motivation; if found, the next state is Contemplation; otherwise, state remains unchanged. In Contemplation, the module tracks whether the client's beliefs (reasons for hesitation) have been adequately addressed; if so, the client transits to Preparation. When the client's preferred change plan has been discussed, the module outputs Termination as the next state.
Raw Eval Metrics: Profile consistency scores (proportion of sessions with positive entailment for Personas, Motivation, Beliefs, and Preferred Change Plans); Spearman's correlation of receptivity (ρ); Average receptivity level (Avg Rec); Motivation rate at the 20th turn (MR@20); Average motivation step (Avg MS); Action KL divergence; ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L; BERTScore; Expert ratings on 1-5 Likert scale for profile consistency and realism; Kappa coefficient
Clinical_Theory: Transtheoretical Model of health behavior change (TTM); Motivational Interviewing (MI)
Agreement Method: Cohen's Kappa (reported as 'Kappa score' and 'Kappa coefficient')

Title: PsyCLIENT: Client Simulation via Conversational Trajectory Modeling for Trainee Practice and Model Evaluation in Mental Health Counseling
Venue: arXiv preprint
Temporal_Modeling_Details: Conversational trajectory modeling: a fixed behavior flow (trajectory) of length T is defined as a sequence F = (B1, ..., Bt, ..., BT) where each Bt represents the set of behavior labels associated with the client's turn at time step t. The LLM generates client utterances conditioned on the predefined trajectory that incorporates explicit behavior labels and content constraints.
Raw Eval Metrics: For RQ1 (Authenticity): Fluency (7-point Likert), Emotional Expressiveness (7-point Likert), Coherence (7-point Likert), Contextual Appropriateness (7-point Likert), Overall Authenticity (7-point Likert). For RQ2 (Discrimination): Discrimination accuracy, Expert confusion rate. For RQ3 (Effectiveness): Listening (7-point Likert), Questioning (7-point Likert), Emotion-handling (7-point Likert), Technique-practice (7-point Likert), Recommendation quality (7-point Likert).
Clinical_Theory: SOAP Note, Case Conceptualization (Hill, 2020), CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy) case conceptualization framework
